limitations: Geometry QA verifies GLB structure and computes heuristic mesh-topology hints; it does not verify architectural fidelity, real-world scale, up-axis, WGS84 georeference, camera calibration, or same-building identity.
Boundary edges can be expected on intentionally open surfaces; disconnected components can also be legitimate separate architectural parts, so topology warnings require visual review.

Unreferenced POSITION entries remain subject to accessor-size and finite-coordinate validation, but do not affect model bounds, model diagonal or topology scale; they are counted and reported separately.
Topology analysis welds near-coincident positions using a scale-relative tolerance and may be skipped above the configured per-primitive vertex limit.
Aggregate bounds apply the selected glTF scene node transforms when available and remain un-georeferenced; topology metrics are mesh-local.
Static QA does not evaluate animation, skinning or morph-target deformation.

warnings: The procedural preview uses explicit BuildingSpec values; it does not infer facade geometry from the visual media.

The procedural preview does not run image understanding; visual media do not alter geometry unless an explicit reconstruction strategy runs. Video frame extraction, photogrammetry and single-image AI are separate optional routes, and selecting a route does not prove that a reconstruction worker ran successfully.
Estimated or AI-proposed properties need review before they are treated as verified: location, footprint, centralDome, frontArcade, floorHeightM, frontFacingAzimuthDegrees.
Image/video visual analysis is not run; media are preserved as provenance and cannot silently change geometry.
frontArcade.heightM is limited to the first storey for structural openings; the emitted arch requires review.
Facade doors, windows and arches are structural openings, but their dimensions and positions are procedural estimates requiring independent review.
Central dome placement is a procedural anchor (footprint-bounds-center); verify its position against independent architectural evidence.
limitations: This is a deterministic parametric mesh, not a photogrammetry or AI reconstruction.

The 44 m x 21 m rectangular footprint is an explicit estimate chosen to approximate the published PWD plinth-area figure; it is not a traced/surveyed footprint.
